other_conditions: Applicant must be a citizen of India
Girl child must be born on or after 15-08-1997
Applicant must be a native of the Union Territory of Pondicherry by birth or have continuous residence for at least 3 years
benefits_summary: Provides a ₹500 National Savings Certificate to the lactating mother of the eligible girl child.
documents_required: Copies of all mandatory documents (self‑attested if required)
